badge.zh: 慢卖快买旗舰 · 默认推荐

name.zh: M6 · 慢卖快买分批轮动旗舰版

summary.en: Trims QQQ in two left-side froth tranches (100% -> 70% -> 45%), exits to 100% SCHD on a 90d-bubble <MA150 breakdown, and snaps 100% back into QQQ on DD <= -18% + VIX/RSI panic.
summary.zh: 泡沫超买分两档慢减（100%→70%→45%），90日泡沫记忆破MA150清至0%全换SCHD；一旦触发回撤≤-18%共振VIX/RSI恐慌极值，一次性100%全卖SCHD满仓杀回QQQ。

accountFit.en: Tax-exempt / IRA / Roth / 401k / Non-US 0% capital-gains accounts
accountFit.zh: 美股免税养老金账户（IRA/Roth/401k）及非美居民 0 资本利得税账户首选

summary.en: Hold 100% QQQ : 0% SCHD whenever Nasdaq-100 Pos-PE < 33.5x and FCF Yield > 2.35%, ignoring normal bull-market pullbacks.
summary.zh: 当纳指盈利股聚合 Pos-PE < 33.5x 且 FCF 收益率 > 2.35% 时，坚定持有 100% QQQ : 0% SCHD，无视牛市正常回调拒绝打脸。

summary.en: Trim to 70% QQQ at Pos-PE >= 33.5x & Wk-RSI >= 70; trim to 45% at Pos-PE >= 36.0x (or FCF <= 2.20% & Wk-RSI >= 72); exit to 0% QQQ (100% SCHD) on close < MA150 (-0.5%) with 90d bubble memory.
summary.zh: Pos-PE ≥ 33.5x 且周RSI ≥ 70 减至 70%；PE ≥ 36x（或FCF率 ≤ 2.20%且周RSI ≥ 72）再减至 45%；90日内曾触及泡沫且跌破 MA150 清至 0% 全换 SCHD。

title.zh: 恐慌共振一把全卖 SCHD 满仓抄底 (+2.59%/年)

summary.en: Once out of bubble zone (Pos-PE <= 28.5x & FCF Yield >= 2.75%) with 2Y drawdown DD <= -18%, if VIX >= 32 OR Daily RSI <= 28 (Wk-RSI <= 35) OR Pos-PE <= 24.5x, liquidate 100% SCHD into QQQ immediately!
summary.zh: 安全前提（PE ≤ 28.5x 且 FCF率 ≥ 2.75%）+ 2年回撤 DD ≤ -18%，叠加 VIX ≥ 32 或 日RSI ≤ 28 或 PE ≤ 24.5x 任一信号，一次性全卖 SCHD 100% 满仓杀回 QQQ！

title.zh: 右侧趋势兜底买回与低频 T+1 纪律

summary.en: If earnings digest multiples without a -18% crash (Pos-PE <= 31.0x & FCF Yield >= 2.55%) and QQQ reclaims MA150 + 1.5%, re-enter 100% QQQ. 10-day min hold, T+1 close execution, 5 bps/side cost.
summary.zh: 若未深跌便靠盈利增长消化估值（PE ≤ 31x 且 FCF率 ≥ 2.55%）并重新站稳 MA150 + 1.5%，右侧顺势满仓买回。10日防抖锁定期，T+1收盘成交、双边5 bps成本。

signalLabel.zh: 科网泡沫破 MA150 清仓

explanation.en: 90d peak Pos-PE hit 69.5x (FCF Yield 1.34%) and QQQ broke below MA150; rotated 100% into dividend value near the Dot-Com top.
explanation.zh: 90日峰值PE高达69.5x（FCF率仅1.34%）且收盘跌破MA150，果断清仓切换高股息逃离科网大顶！

signalLabel.zh: 左侧估值消化抄底

explanation.en: After a -68.3% washout, Pos-PE compressed from 69.5x to 25.8x (3Y Z = -1.73s, VIX = 29.9), triggering tactical QQQ re-entry.
explanation.zh: 经历 -68.3% 深度出清后 Pos-PE 从69.5x压至25.8x（3Y估值Z=-1.73σ），触发第一轮左侧买回。

signalLabel.zh: 熊市反弹估值飙升减至45%

explanation.en: Post-9/11 rebound pushed trailing Pos-PE back to 42.2x with FCF Yield 1.48%; trimmed QQQ down to 45% before the 2002 final leg down.
explanation.zh: 反弹后盈利下滑推升Pos-PE重回42.2x（FCF率1.48%），提前减仓至45%规避2002年最后一跌。

signalLabel.zh: 科网世纪大底满仓抄底

explanation.en: FCF Yield reached 3.62% with VIX = 34.1 and 3Y Val-Z = -1.75s at -76% drawdown; rotated 100% into QQQ days before the secular trough.
explanation.zh: 泡沫彻底出清（FCF率升至3.62% + VIX=34.1恐慌极值），在科网世纪大底前一周100%满仓买回QQQ！

signalLabel.zh: 一档慢卖锁定泡沫利润 (70%)

explanation.en: After holding 100% QQQ uninterrupted for 17.8 years, ZIRP melt-up pushed Pos-PE to 34.2x with Weekly RSI > 70; trimmed 30% into SCHD.
explanation.zh: 连续满仓持有QQQ近18年后，疫情放水推升PE突破34.2x且周RSI超70，启动一档慢卖减仓30%换入SCHD。

signalLabel.zh: 二档慢卖再锁狂热溢价 (45%)

explanation.en: Pos-PE surged past 36.2x (3Y Val-Z = +3.52s, Daily RSI = 74.2); trimmed another 25% to 45% QQQ : 55% SCHD.
explanation.zh: Pos-PE冲上36.2x（3Y估值Z高达+3.52σ，日RSI=74.2），执行二档慢卖降至 45% QQQ : 55% SCHD。

signalLabel.zh: 加息前夕破 MA150 清仓避险

explanation.en: 90d peak PE was 34.8x and QQQ broke below MA150 ahead of Fed rate hikes; exited to 100% SCHD (which returned 0.0% in 2022 vs QQQ -35.1%).
explanation.zh: 90日峰值PE达34.8x且美联储加息前夕跌破MA150，剩余45%全部清仓换入SCHD（完美规避2022主跌浪）。

signalLabel.zh: 俄乌恐慌 VIX=35 满仓快反

explanation.en: Drawdown hit -19.9% with VIX spiking to 35.1, Pos-PE down to 26.2x, and FCF Yield 3.17%; went 100% QQQ and captured a +9.0% tactical rip.
explanation.zh: 回撤达 -19.9%、VIX飙至35.1且PE消化至26.2x（FCF率3.17%），满仓抄底抓获 +9% 急弹。

signalLabel.zh: 反抽未过 MA150 止盈回防

explanation.en: Bounce narrowed drawdown above -12% while QQQ remained capped below MA150 with active 90d bubble memory; locked +9% gain back into SCHD.
explanation.zh: 反弹使回撤收窄至 -12.7% 但仍受制于MA150下方且90日泡沫记忆未消，果断锁定波段利润退守SCHD。

signalLabel.zh: 估值回归安全区满仓买回

explanation.en: Drawdown exceeded -18.2% with Pos-PE reset to 26.5x, FCF Yield 3.19%, and 3Y Val-Z = -0.42s; re-entered 100% QQQ into the 2023 AI bull.
explanation.zh: 回撤超 -18.2% 且估值消化至 26.5x（FCF率3.19%，3Y估值Z=-0.42σ），满仓买回并吃满2023 AI首轮主升浪。

signalLabel.zh: AI 拔估值一档慢卖 (70%)

explanation.en: ChatGPT/AI multiple expansion pushed Pos-PE to 34.0x with Weekly RSI >= 70 (Daily RSI 74.4); trimmed 30% to SCHD.
explanation.zh: AI首轮拔估值推升Pos-PE达34.0x且周RSI超70（日RSI=74.4），一档慢卖收割30%利润换入SCHD。

signalLabel.zh: AI 狂热二档慢卖 (45%)

explanation.en: Pos-PE exceeded 36.4x with FCF Yield down to 2.43% and VIX at 13.3 complacency; trimmed QQQ exposure to 45%.
explanation.zh: Pos-PE突破36.4x（FCF率降至2.43%，VIX低至13.3极度自满），二档慢卖降至 45% QQQ。

signalLabel.zh: 美债破5%跌破 MA150 防守切换

explanation.en: 10Y Treasury yield spike pushed QQQ below MA150 after a 37.0x 90d peak PE; rotated remaining 45% into SCHD, avoiding the 2024–25 carry/tariff crash.
explanation.zh: 10年期美债冲5%令QQQ在37.0x泡沫峰后跌破MA150，切换至SCHD并成功躲过2024–25套息与关税暴跌。

signalLabel.zh: 关税崩盘 VIX=47 教科书级满仓抄底！

explanation.en: Tariff shock drove QQQ down -21.4% with VIX exploding to 47.0, Daily RSI = 25.0, Pos-PE 28.1x, and FCF Yield 2.90%; liquidated 100% SCHD into QQQ at the exact bottom!
explanation.zh: 关税闪崩回撤 -21.4%、VIX飙至47.0、日RSI跌至25.0且FCF率回到2.90%，一把清空SCHD 100%满仓杀回QQQ精准抄底！

signalLabel.zh: 快反急涨 +12.2% 止盈回防 SCHD

explanation.en: Captured +12.2% rebound in 15 sessions ($420.78 -> $472.20); with QQQ still below MA150 under 38.3x 90d peak memory (and subsequent AI CapEx compressing FCF Yield < 2.3%), rotated to SCHD (+56.7% follow-through).
explanation.zh: 15个交易日急涨 +12.2%（$420.78→$472.20）后受制于MA150且随后AI算力开支压低FCF率至2.1%，锁定快反收益并切换SCHD稳健吃满价值主升。

badge.zh: 双锚左侧全进出 · 进攻收益冠军

name.zh: M4 · 双锚左侧全仓轮动进攻版

summary.en: Pure binary 100% QQQ <-> 100% SCHD rotation using dual valuation guardrails + weekly RSI exhaustion on exits and VIX/RSI panic sniping on entries (only 5 switches in 15.1 years).
summary.zh: 纯二元 100% QQQ ⇄ 100% SCHD 全进全出，高估共振周线超买左侧清仓、暴跌共振VIX/低估满仓抄底，15.1年仅换手 5 次，滚动5年胜率高达 98.1%。

accountFit.en: 0% tax accounts seeking highest CAGR (21.39%) with minimal trading frequency
accountFit.zh: 追求最高年化复利（21.39% / 18.55x）且极低换手频率的零资本利得税账户

summary.en: Hold 100% QQQ across multi-year expansions until both absolute bubble valuation and weekly momentum exhaustion trigger simultaneously (only 5 switches in 15.1 years).
summary.zh: 在长达数年的科技扩张期保持 100% QQQ 死拿，15.1年实盘周期仅调仓 5 次，最大化长牛复利连贯性。

title.zh: 双锚左侧高估超买全仓切换 (100% → 0%)

summary.en: When Pos-PE >= 34.5x (or >= 32.5x with 3Y Val-Z >= +1.25s) AND Weekly RSI(14) >= 68 (or Pos-PE >= 35.5x), rotate 100% into defensive SCHD in a single decisive move.
summary.zh: 当 Pos-PE ≥ 34.5x（或 ≥ 32.5x 且 3Y估值Z ≥ +1.25σ）且周线 RSI(14) ≥ 68（或 PE ≥ 35.5x）时，左侧一次性 100% 全换 SCHD。

title.zh: 大回撤共振 VIX / 低估一把满仓杀回

summary.en: Identical left-side sniping engine as M6: DD <= -18% + non-bubble guard (PE <= 28.5x, FCF >= 2.75%) + (VIX >= 32 or Daily RSI <= 28 or PE <= 24.5x) -> 100% QQQ.
summary.zh: 与 M6 共用左侧恐慌狙击引擎：回撤 ≤ -18% + 脱离泡沫护栏 +（VIX ≥ 32 或 日RSI ≤ 28 或 PE ≤ 24.5x）立即全卖 SCHD 满仓 QQQ。

summary.en: If earnings growth compresses Nasdaq-100 Pos-PE to <= 23.5x without an acute VIX spike, rotate 100% back into QQQ. Best suited for tax-exempt accounts seeking maximum CAGR (21.39%).
summary.zh: 若业绩高增令纳指 Pos-PE 自然回落至 ≤ 23.5x，无条件全仓切回 QQQ。适合追求极致年化收益（21.39% / 18.55x）的免税账户。

signalLabel.zh: 科网泡沫消化左侧全仓买入

explanation.en: Pos-PE compressed to 25.8x (3Y Val-Z = -1.73s) at -68.3% drawdown; switched 0% -> 100% QQQ.
explanation.zh: 科网崩盘回撤 -68.3% 后 Pos-PE 压至 25.8x（3Y估值Z=-1.73σ），全仓切入QQQ。

signalLabel.zh: 双锚泡沫+周RSI超买全换SCHD

explanation.en: Pos-PE hit 32.4x with 3Y Val-Z = +3.19s and Weekly RSI >= 68; rotated 100% into SCHD.
explanation.zh: Pos-PE达32.4x且3Y估值Z高达+3.19σ伴随周RSI超买，左侧100%切换至SCHD。

signalLabel.zh: 2022 加息熊市 VIX=35 全仓抄底

explanation.en: Drawdown hit -19.9% with VIX = 35.1 and Pos-PE = 26.2x (FCF Yield 3.17%); switched 100% back into QQQ.
explanation.zh: 回撤 -19.9% 共振 VIX=35.1 且 FCF率升至3.17%，左侧100%全卖SCHD满仓买回QQQ。

signalLabel.zh: AI 34.9x PE + 超买左侧全换SCHD

explanation.en: Pos-PE reached 34.9x with Daily RSI = 76.8 and Weekly RSI > 68; locked profits into 100% SCHD.
explanation.zh: AI首轮飙升令Pos-PE达34.9x且日RSI高达76.8，左侧全仓止盈换入SCHD。

signalLabel.zh: 关税崩盘 VIX=47 全仓满手抄底！

explanation.en: VIX hit 47.0, Daily RSI = 25.0, DD = -21.4% at $420.78; went 100% QQQ and rode the rally straight to $558.01 (+32.6%)!
explanation.zh: VIX飙至47、日RSI=25，在$420.78全仓杀回QQQ并一路持有至$558.01（单笔怒赚 +32.6%）！

signalLabel.zh: 反弹至 35.3x PE 左侧全换SCHD

explanation.en: After +32.6% surge from the April bottom, Pos-PE reached 35.3x (FCF Yield down to 2.25%) with Weekly RSI > 68; rotated 100% into SCHD.
explanation.zh: 自4月大底暴涨 +32.6% 后 Pos-PE 重回 35.3x（FCF率压至2.25%）且周RSI超买，高位全仓切换SCHD防守。

badge.zh: 50%永久底仓 · 应税账户优解

name.en: M7 · 50% Permanent QQQ Core + 50% M6 Tactical Sleeve
name.zh: M7 · 50% QQQ 永久底仓 + 50% M6 战术轮动版

summary.en: Holds a permanent untaxed 50% QQQ core and runs M6 slow-sell / fast-buy on the 50% tactical sleeve (total QQQ exposure 50%..100%), ranking #1 after 20% capital gains tax.
summary.zh: 保留 50% 低成本 QQQ 底仓永不卖出免交重税，仅用 50% 战术仓执行 M6 慢卖快买（总 QQQ 仓位 50%–100%），20% 资本利得税后年化高居战术策略第一。

accountFit.en: US taxable brokerage accounts (15%–20%+ capital gains tax) or investors averse to 0% QQQ
accountFit.zh: 需缴纳 15%–20%+ 资本利得税的美股应税账户，或厌恶完全空仓 QQQ 的稳健配置者

title.zh: 50% 低成本 QQQ 永久免税底仓

summary.en: Lock 50% of portfolio in permanent buy-and-hold QQQ that is NEVER sold, deferring unrealized capital gains taxes indefinitely and eliminating bull-market FOMO.
summary.zh: 50% 仓位作为永久死拿的 QQQ 核心底仓永不卖出，彻底规避美股高浮盈清仓的资本利得税流失，并根治牛市踏空焦虑。

summary.en: Only the 50% tactical sleeve rotates into SCHD during bubble froth and <MA150 breakdowns, bringing total portfolio exposure smoothly to 50% QQQ : 50% SCHD in tech bears.
summary.zh: 仅用另外 50% 战术仓在泡沫期分批换入 SCHD，破 MA150 时形成 50% QQQ + 50% SCHD 攻守兼备结构，年化换手率砍半至 23.2%。

title.en: 100% Full QQQ Offense at Panic Troughs
title.zh: 危机恐慌极值恢复 100% QQQ 满仓进攻

summary.en: When M6 triggers left-side panic sniping (DD <= -18% + VIX >= 32 / RSI <= 28), sell the 50% SCHD tactical buffer (often near flat cost basis, minimal tax!) to reach 100% QQQ.
summary.zh: 当触发大回撤+VIX/RSI恐慌极值抄底信号时，卖出浮盈较小的 50% SCHD 避险仓（税损极低），恢复 100% QQQ 满仓吃满反转弹性！

title.zh: 20% 资本利得税率下战术策略税后第一

summary.en: At a 20% US capital gains tax rate, M7 delivers 17.99% after-tax CAGR (highest of all tactical strategies) while cutting QQQ max drawdown from -35.12% to -28.56% (95.9% 5Y win rate).
summary.zh: 在 20% 资本利得税严苛测试下，M7 税后年化达 17.99%（居所有轮动方案之首），同时将最大回撤从 -35.12% 压至 -28.56%，5年胜率高达 95.9%。

explanation.zh: 【50%永久QQQ底仓 + 50%战术仓】AI首轮拔估值推升Pos-PE达34.0x且周RSI超70（日RSI=74.4），一档慢卖收割30%利润换入SCHD。

explanation.zh: 【50%永久QQQ底仓 + 50%战术仓】Pos-PE突破36.4x（FCF率降至2.43%，VIX低至13.3极度自满），二档慢卖降至 45% QQQ。

signalLabel.zh: 美债破5%跌破 MA150 防守切换

explanation.en: [50% Permanent QQQ Core + 50% M6 Sleeve] 10Y Treasury yield spike pushed QQQ below MA150 after a 37.0x 90d peak PE; rotated remaining 45% into SCHD, avoiding the 2024–25 carry/tariff crash.
explanation.zh: 【50%永久QQQ底仓 + 50%战术仓】10年期美债冲5%令QQQ在37.0x泡沫峰后跌破MA150，切换至SCHD并成功躲过2024–25套息与关税暴跌。

signalLabel.zh: 关税崩盘 VIX=47 教科书级满仓抄底！

explanation.en: [50% Permanent QQQ Core + 50% M6 Sleeve] Tariff shock drove QQQ down -21.4% with VIX exploding to 47.0, Daily RSI = 25.0, Pos-PE 28.1x, and FCF Yield 2.90%; liquidated 100% SCHD into QQQ at the exact bottom!
explanation.zh: 【50%永久QQQ底仓 + 50%战术仓】关税闪崩回撤 -21.4%、VIX飙至47.0、日RSI跌至25.0且FCF率回到2.90%，一把清空SCHD 100%满仓杀回QQQ精准抄底！

signalLabel.zh: 快反急涨 +12.2% 止盈回防 SCHD

explanation.en: [50% Permanent QQQ Core + 50% M6 Sleeve] Captured +12.2% rebound in 15 sessions ($420.78 -> $472.20); with QQQ still below MA150 under 38.3x 90d peak memory (and subsequent AI CapEx compressing FCF Yield < 2.3%), rotated to SCHD (+56.7% follow-through).
explanation.zh: 【50%永久QQQ底仓 + 50%战术仓】15个交易日急涨 +12.2%（$420.78→$472.20）后受制于MA150且随后AI算力开支压低FCF率至2.1%，锁定快反收益并切换SCHD稳健吃满价值主升。

title.en: Trap 1 · Oct 2000 "Fake-Cheap" Valuation-MA Disaster (-72% After Entry)
title.zh: 陷阱 1 · 2000年10月泡沫破灭初期的「假便宜陷阱」（抄底后再暴跌 -72%）

body.en: 1998–2000 Dot-Com mania dragged the 3-year Pos-PE moving average up to 51x. In Oct 2000 (-26.4% off high), QQQ still traded at an extreme 43.1x PE (1.02% FCF Yield), yet sat -0.36s below its 51x 3Y-MA — tricking pure valuation-MA rules into buying 100% QQQ right before an additional -72% collapse.
body.zh: 1998–2000 科网狂热将 3 年估值均线拉高至 51x。2000年10月 QQQ 回撤 -26.4% 时 Pos-PE 仍高达 43.1x（FCF率仅 1.02%，极度昂贵），却因低于 51x 均线（Z = -0.36σ）被纯估值均线误判为“便宜”满仓接刀，随后再惨跌 -72%！

guardrail.en: Dual-Anchor Fix: Hard Buy Ceiling requires Pos-PE <= 28.5x AND FCF Yield >= 2.75% before any left-side buy.
guardrail.zh: 双锚护栏破局：硬性要求脱离绝对泡沫（Pos-PE ≤ 28.5x 且 FCF率 ≥ 2.75%）才允许左侧抄底，27年六大历史大底 100% 落在此安全区内。

title.en: Trap 2 · May 2013 "Fake-Expensive" Early-Exit Trap (Missed 5Y Secular Bull)
title.zh: 陷阱 2 · 2013年5月危机修复初期的「假高估陷阱」（16.3x PE 过早下车踏空五年）

body.en: Post-GFC depressed multiples (2009–2012 at 13x–15x PE) anchored the 3-year valuation MA down at 15.2x. In May 2013, a mild re-rating to just 16.3x PE (5.68% FCF Yield — dirt cheap!) pierced +1.35s above the 3Y-MA, forcing pure Z-score models out of QQQ at the dawn of the cloud bull run.
body.zh: 2009–2012 次贷余波将 3 年估值均线压低至 15.2x。2013年5月 QQQ 仅温和修复至 16.3x PE（FCF率高达 5.68%，实质白菜价），却突破 3 年均线 +1.35σ，导致纯估值均线过早清仓换入 SCHD，踏空整轮云计算主升浪！

guardrail.en: Dual-Anchor Fix: Hard Sell Floor forbids any valuation trim until Pos-PE >= 33.5x or FCF Yield <= 2.35%.
guardrail.zh: 双锚护栏破局：硬性设定绝对昂贵下限（Pos-PE ≥ 33.5x 或 FCF率 ≤ 2.35%），2011–2018 连续近8年零换手吃满 +256.5% 涨幅。

condition.en: Aggregate Pos-PE < 33.5x AND FCF Yield > 2.35% (healthy growth regime)
condition.zh: 纳指盈利股聚合 Pos-PE < 33.5x 且 FCF 收益率 > 2.35%（合理成长期，无视普通回调）

condition.en: Pos-PE >= 33.5x AND Weekly RSI(14) >= 70 (initial bubble + overbought)
condition.zh: Pos-PE ≥ 33.5x 且周线 Weekly RSI(14) ≥ 70（泡沫初现 + 超买）

condition.en: Pos-PE >= 36.0x OR (FCF Yield <= 2.20% AND Weekly RSI >= 72)
condition.zh: Pos-PE ≥ 36.0x 或（FCF 收益率 ≤ 2.20% 且周 RSI ≥ 72）（极度狂热）

condition.en: 90d Bubble Memory (Peak PE >= 33.5x or Min FCF <= 2.35% with 3Y Z >= +0.9s) AND Close < MA150 (-0.5%)
condition.zh: 过去90日曾触及泡沫区（峰值PE ≥ 33.5x 或最低FCF率 ≤ 2.35% 且 3Y估值Z ≥ +0.9σ）且收盘跌破 MA150 (-0.5%)

condition.en: Non-Bubble (PE <= 28.5x & FCF >= 2.75%) + DD <= -18% + ANY OF: VIX >= 32 | Daily RSI <= 28 (Wk <= 35) | PE <= 24.5x
condition.zh: 脱离泡沫（PE ≤ 28.5x 且 FCF率 ≥ 2.75%）+ 回撤 DD ≤ -18% + 任一信号：VIX ≥ 32 | 日RSI ≤ 28 | PE ≤ 24.5x

condition.en: Multiples digested (Pos-PE <= 31.0x & FCF Yield >= 2.55%) AND Close > MA150 + 1.5%
condition.zh: 盈利增长消化估值（Pos-PE ≤ 31.0x 且 FCF率 ≥ 2.55%）并站稳 MA150 + 1.5%

note.zh: 90日泡沫记忆破MA150果断清仓换高股息，将QQQ -82.9%毁灭性崩盘压缩至 -27.8%
note.en: 90d bubble memory + <MA150 exit rotated to dividend value, cutting QQQ -82.9% crash to -27.8%

note.zh: 2007年纳指PE仅22x无科技泡沫，系统性银行危机中成长与高股息同跌，未产生无效换手损耗
note.en: 2007 QQQ PE was 22x (non-bubble banking crisis); QQQ and dividend stocks fell identically without whipsaw drag

note.zh: 双锚下限护栏屏蔽2013年“假高估陷阱”，零换手100%死拿QQQ吃满 +256.5% 主升浪
note.en: Dual-anchor floor blocked the 2013 Fake-Expensive trap, holding 100% QQQ for the full +256.5% bull run

note.zh: 顶部PE未达33.5x泡沫线，按常态回调坚定持仓穿越，避免底部割肉踏空2019反弹
note.en: Peak PE stayed below 33.5x bubble threshold; held through normal correction without bottom whipsaw

note.zh: 无差别的23天流动性闪崩（SCHD跌-32.8%比QQQ -27.9%更深），满仓QQQ直接迎接V型暴涨
note.en: 23-day indiscriminate liquidity shock (SCHD -32.8% fell more than QQQ -27.9%); stayed 100% QQQ into V-rebound

note.zh: 慢卖分批止盈锁定部分泡沫红利，同时享受SCHD疫后价值复苏，斩获 +139.5% 跑赢死拿QQQ
note.en: Staged froth trims locked gains while capturing post-COVID value rebound (+139.5% vs QQQ +139.0%)

note.zh: 2022年1月跌破MA150清仓换入全年0%横盘的SCHD，随后左侧低估买回，跑赢QQQ +15.9个百分点！
note.en: Jan 2022 <MA150 exit into flat SCHD (0.0%) + April valuation re-entry beat QQQ by +15.9 percentage points!

note.zh: 2022左侧满仓抄底吃满前半段暴涨，2023下半年PE冲上36.4x后慢卖分批兑现（M7底仓版斩获+76.2%）
note.en: Captured early AI surge from 2022 left-side buy, then trimmed into 36.4x PE froth (M7 Core captured +76.2%)

note.zh: 战术仓提前驻守SCHD避风港，在QQQ暴跌 -16.9% 期间仅微跌 -1.6%（超额护体 +15.3%）！
note.en: Defensive SCHD positioning limited drawdown to -1.6% while QQQ plunged -16.9% (+15.3% protection)!

note.zh: 2025-04-07 VIX=47满仓杀回QQQ锁定快反利润，随后切换高股息吃满价值补涨，斩获 +68.1% 超额胜出（M4达 +89.9%）
note.en: 2025-04-07 VIX=47 all-in QQQ snipe + value rotation delivered +68.1% vs QQQ +64.5% (M4 hit +89.9%)

actionInstruction.zh: 战术仓维持 100% SCHD 防守！切勿在回撤仅 -10.5%、VIX 仅 19.3 且 FCF 收益率仅 2.07% 的半途过早打光 SCHD 子弹。

actionInstruction.zh: 维持 100% SCHD 防守（自 2025-07-22 高位清仓锁定利润），静待回撤 ≤ -18% 共振 VIX ≥ 32 / 日RSI ≤ 28 或 PE ≤ 23.5x。

title.en: PE vs. Free Cash Flow Scissors Alert (25.7x Pos-PE vs. 2.07% FCF Yield)
title.zh: 盈利 PE 与自由现金流剪刀差预警（Pos-PE 25.7x vs FCF率 2.07%）

detail.en: Mega-cap accounting net income lowered Pos-PE to 25.67x, but hyperscaler AI CapEx compressed aggregate Nasdaq-100 FCF Yield to 2.07% (48.2x P/FCF, 6.59x P/S) — still inside the cash-flow expensive zone (< 2.35%).
detail.zh: 科技巨头账面利润增长使 Pos-PE 回落至 25.67x，但巨额 AI 算力资本开支导致纳指聚合自由现金流收益率压缩至仅 2.07%（P/FCF 高达 48.2x，P/S 6.59x），现金流维度仍处昂贵警戒区（< 2.35%）。

title.zh: 预案 B · 右侧现金流修复顺势买回（站稳均线切回 100% QQQ）
